authored/gold.name: Gold
authored/gold.reason: Gold drops in every map and no market will ever list it, so the trade site and the exchange both answer no to a question about selling that says nothing about dropping. Authoring the row is how a person answers it instead. It carries no price for the same reason: gold buys things inside the game rather than on the market, so nothing publishes a Chaos rate and nobody wants to maintain one. Its category is tiered on stack size instead.

authored/transfigured-gem.name: Transfigured Gem
authored/transfigured-gem.reason: The 249 transfigured gems are each marked filterable: false, because the client rejects Absolution of Inspiring as a base type. A filter still draws all of them, with TransfiguredGem True — the block exists, the names do not. This row is that block. It replaces nothing: the 249 stay where they are so a price can attach to each gem by name.

authored/vaal-aspect.name: Vaal Aspect
authored/vaal-aspect.reason: Four ids, one display name, and the only thing separating them is the art file. A filter can write BaseType == "Vaal Aspect" and nothing finer, so four rows offering a choice the filter cannot make is four ways to get the same block. One row says what can actually be written.
